rules.rule:
Heart of Magic panel JavaScript (PrismaUI, rendered in game by Ultralight: a CPU-painted WebKit engine WITHOUT a JIT). The project's rules (CLAUDE.md) override generic JS advice.

#### Language (Ultralight compatibility)
- `var` ONLY. `let`, `const`, arrow functions, template literals, classes, destructuring, spread, default parameters, `?.`, `??`, ES modules (`import`/`export`) are violations.
- Globals / IIFE module pattern (objects attached to window); no bundler.
- `==`/`!=` should be strict (`===`/`!==`) unless a null/undefined check is intended and commented.

#### Correctness
- Code that can never run, variables never read, large commented-out blocks.
- Null/undefined access on values that can be missing (DOM lookups by id, optional modules checked with `typeof X !== 'undefined'`, saved settings from older versions).
- State machines and flags (pending flags, dirty flags, timers): every path resets what it set; no double callbacks; timers cleared.
- Anything the plugin calls by name (window.onXxx callbacks) or the panel sends with callCpp must exist on both sides.

#### Performance (the goal is NO visible frame drops in game)
- Per-frame work on the canvas: no allocations in hot loops (objects, closures, arrays, string concatenation per node/edge), no work proportional to the whole tree when a part would do, no gradients/shadows/filters or full-size image scaling per frame, no getComputedStyle/measureText in loops without a cache.
- Repaints of the whole tree layer must be avoided or spread over frames; frame requests must not spin forever.

#### Project conventions
- Files over 600 lines should be split; named constants instead of magic numbers; JSDoc-style comments for non-obvious logic.
- Colours come from design tokens / theme CSS variables, not hard-coded, and must work in all designs (Classic, Modern Dark, Arcane, Night Grimoire, Chalkboard).
- Every user-visible string goes through t('key') with the key present in all 13 lang/*.json files.
- Documentation (docs/*.md, modules/README.md) must be updated with behaviour changes.

#### Security
- No innerHTML with unescaped user or mod-supplied text (spell names, plugin names), no eval/Function/string setTimeout, no prototype changes on built-ins.

Heart of Magic SKSE plugin (C++23, CommonLibSSE-NG). Project rules from CLAUDE.md, in addition to the generic C++ rules:
- RE::/SKSE:: types and methods must exist in plugins/external/commonlibsse-ng headers (no guessed APIs).
- No raw new/delete; no manual mutex lock()/unlock() - use lock_guard/unique_lock.
- Named constants (k-prefixed, static constexpr) instead of magic numbers; files over 600 lines should be split.
- Naming: PascalCase types and functions, m_ members, g_ globals, k constants.
- Game state is touched only on the game thread (tasks via the SKSE task interface); worker threads never touch RE:: objects or the UI directly and never let exceptions escape.
- Code mirrored in JS (the tree declutter pass: treebuilder/Layout*.cpp vs modules/layout*.js) must stay bit-identical in results; flag any change applied to one side only.
- Documentation (docs/*.md) must be updated with behaviour changes.
